data.revised_prompt: A high-quality 3D chibi educational app avatar icon, centered and readable at small sizes, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, square 1:1 composition. Show only one fictional Chinese schoolgirl, age 8–14, clearly a student. Head-focused close-up: face and hair together occupy about 75%–85% of the canvas, with only a tiny bit of white school collar visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. Front-facing or slight 2/3 view, complete hair outline fully visible, no crop at top or chin. Distinct hairstyle: two side braids coiled into twin buns, with thin airy bangs in the center; no bow. Expression: curious, clever, friendly smile. Large bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, delicate modeling, soft materials, polished 3D educational app style, clearly a student avatar. Background must fully fill the entire square canvas edge-to-edge with a low-saturation light lake-blue solid color, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene, no text. Only a small white school lapel/collar is visible, no emblem, no logo. Strongly distinct silhouette and facial features that remain recognizable at 48px. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, gestures, props, teacher, adult, headset, headphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top-of-head crop, hair crop, chin crop, small face, off-center subject, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular avatar frame, ring, bright halo, complex scene, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, multiple characters, photorealistic human photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low resolution, deformed facial features.
